const.zh-Hant: 原斷言有誤且未曾採用

const.aliases: Resolve only legitimate delivered sameAs/sameAsBody aliases. Never substitute a different unit, source or occurrence.
const.normalization: Use exactly the delivered body/excerpt, after any delivery normalization. A raw-source spelling absent from delivery cannot anchor a citation.
const.truncation: Cite only the delivered substring; omitted text and its provenance are not evidence.
const.overlap: Count exact matches at successive UTF-16 start positions including overlaps. Overlapping occurrence ambiguity requires existing contextual resolution, never an arbitrary substitute.
const.extraction_anchor: {turn_id,quote,occurrence}; exact matching, one-based overlapping occurrences, harness-computed UTF-16 offsets; no fuzzy normalization.

const.prefix_exclusion: A name must match the complete token: both adjacent characters must be outside [A-Za-z0-9_-]. demo7 inside demo70 or demo7_suffix is invalid.
const.anchoring: Own-name and reference quote equals the submitted name before normalization, in a source_turns current-batch turn, exact one-based overlapping occurrence. Roles are semantic assertions, never inferred from substring presence.
const.normalization: NFKC, collapse whitespace and trim; preserve case. No case folding, phonetics, punctuation deletion or undeclared aliases.
const.own_name: The newly introduced record, not the old record in correct record ...; null if absent.
const.predecessor_refs: Quote each referenced record once at its current-batch mention; never guess an earlier turn. The private gold-free registry supplies target event/source identities before arm fan-out.

const.policy: All worked-example worlds, names, routes, source texts, outputs and case-specific mappings are excluded from research/calibration authoring. Shared primitives such as Boolean false and canonical units are not banned. Reserve the demo name namespace; never use examples as sampled worlds.
